WITH patient_averages AS (
    SELECT
        P.ID,
        P.SEX,
        AVG(L.ALB - L.TP) AS alb_tp_avg,
        AVG(L.APTT - L.PT) AS aptt_pt_avg
    FROM Patient AS P
    JOIN Laboratory AS L ON L.ID = P.ID
    GROUP BY P.ID, P.SEX
),
sex_averages AS (
    SELECT
        SEX,
        AVG(alb_tp_avg) AS alb_tp_avg,
        AVG(aptt_pt_avg) AS aptt_pt_avg
    FROM patient_averages
    GROUP BY SEX
),
threshold AS (
    SELECT AVG(aptt_pt_avg) AS mean_aptt_pt_avg
    FROM sex_averages
)
SELECT
    AVG(S.alb_tp_avg) AS avg_alb_minus_tp,
    AVG(S.aptt_pt_avg) AS avg_aptt_minus_pt,
    AVG(S.aptt_pt_avg - T.mean_aptt_pt_avg) AS avg_excess_over_sex_mean
FROM sex_averages AS S
CROSS JOIN threshold AS T
WHERE S.aptt_pt_avg > T.mean_aptt_pt_avg
